description: Machine Learning, Deep Learning and simulation in general are expected to work together in the future, meaning compatibility of traditional numerical algorithms with deep learning will become important.

The algorithms existing for HPDA and AI are seen as an emerging field, indicating a rapid evolution and the need for standards and classification. Competitors like Univa, AWS, and Intel describe the Machine Learning/AI and HPC area as a 'wild west'.

Symbolic computing may replace 20 to 30% of numerical computing, presenting an alternative or additional approach. Firms such as Mathematica and Maple differentiate by offering symbolic computing alongside numerical libraries.

Rivalry among existing competitors in the numerical algorithms industry is high. Python and Julia challenge the competitive equilibrium, offering free, interoperable alternatives. MIP Optimization firms also compete in a growing market.
This Five Forces Analysis indicates the nature and strength of forces in the Numerical Libraries Industry, essential for NAG to consider in strategy formulation.
